description: Get an auto-annotation run's status for a dataset by slug, owner/slug, or a ul://owner/datasets/slug URI. Surfaces activeJob and lastRun unmodified: both null means the dataset has never run one; activeJob carries progress for a run in flight; lastRun carries failed/stopped booleans plus results, or an error when the run failed.

dataset.description: Dataset ref by slug, owner/slug, or a ul://owner/datasets/slug URI.

name: auto_annotate_status
